charts.title: TOI-5799 c: orbits around TOI-5799
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5799's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5799 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Yalçinkaya et al. 2025 (2025A&A...702A.209Y), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname YALCINKAYA_ET_AL_2025): P 14.010449 d

charts.title: TOI-5799 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5799 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (54, 81) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 328081248, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 7 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min late; 7-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 2 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
